Tweet by @theo (Theo - t3.gg)
Author bio: Full time CEO @t3dotchat. Part time YouTuber, investor, and developer
Text: The new T3 Code sidebar is available on the latest nightly build. It's a toggle in settings. It's a VERY different workflow.

Think of it more like an inbox. When you're done with a thread, click the "settle" button and it slides to the bottom.

This has helped me "finish" more work than I ever have before. I'm loving this workflow. Let me know what you think if you try it!
